reviews.title: Excellent quality fans, but read review before purchase. Edited 6/9/25
reviews.comment: So both fan sets had a fan frames crushed and broken upon arrival/shipping (Both standard and reverse flow 140mm x3 packs).  If your set arrives broken they wont ship you a replacement set apparently, you have to get a refund and purchase again so its a hassle for the customer just FYI. Fans themselves are nice quality, heavy fans and the RGB diffusion is quite good. CFM is also very good. returns to get a working set of 6 fans has proven troubling so far. No noise from them at all when working. Not great value as you can find as good CFM in other fans without RGB but for that light RGB aesthetic and good performance these will do the job nicely, provided they are damaged. Edit update 6/9/25 After reading my review Eric from Geometric Future Reached out via email and went ahead and sent a replacement set free of charge for the hassle caused in this purchase. As a consumer one can not say enough about a company that treats customers in such a manor. It's the hallmark of not only a class operation and ownership but also of folks who actually enjoy making their product for the consumer and genuinely want them to be satisfied. Very rare in this day and age. Many thanks to Eric and Geometric. I have adjusted the review accordingly to reflect this Above and Beyond customer service.

reviews.comment: These are great fans.  Super quiet and move a ton of air.  Definitely a good buy in my book.
reviews.author: Gary Hillhouse

reviews.title: Good Quiet Fans
reviews.comment: These are the 140mm, I have the 3 forward and 3 reverse installed.  I have had zero issues with noise, even at full speed only the sound of moving air.  The LED's are bright and compatible with Asus Aura, and MSI light (only systems I've tested them on.  Attached a video to see them.  Love the unique and minimal design.  Even when they are set to rainbow-barf mode they still pull off looking good. These are quality fans built well.  They move a lot of air quietly.  Only complaint is the short cables from the fan for connections.  While it does make cable managment a little easier, if you want to spread them out you'll need to buy some adapters/extensions.  Wish it came with some included... would have gladly paid an extra $5 for each fan to have extension cables included.
reviews.author: Mr Romo

reviews.title: Excellent Fans - Love Them - only disappointment is the availability of different variants
reviews.comment: Love these fans - Excellent airflow - silent - durable bearings - easy to install - clean aesthetic look - touch of class in rgb without being over-the-top Seriously wish the 140mm fan was available in single black w/normal blades and that the 120mm fans were available both in single and 3pk in both standard and reverse blade designs - I would promptly replace ALL 6 of my 120mm fans (3 standard blade on my AIO & 3 reverse blades for my front/side intake) as well as the single rear exhaust 140mm if they were.
reviews.author: 2loki4u

reviews.title: Possibly the best reverse RGB 140mm case fans you can buy
reviews.comment: These are so well built that I am considering replacing some cheapo fans with more of these Squamas (UPDATE: I did!) The RGB is also the best I've ever seen on a fan (if you are like me and don't like excessive glow). They are setup to daisy chain and the extension is long enough to reach behind and across my case's cable runs. Only knock I'd say is that these 140s get loud at full speed, but it is because they are moving an ungodly amount of air... so no stars off. 5 stars. (These are the row on the right)
